name: Kurwitu Ventures Ltd
source: Kurwitu Ventures Ltd financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2020 | NSEBLOCKED 17 Nov 2026: the shares have been suspended since 2017 for non-compliance and the company applied to leave the NSE in April 2023. The newest audited accounts on the Capital Markets Authority archive are the six months to 30 June 2022, a shortened period after the change from a December year end: https://annualreport.cma.or.ke/media/INVESTMENT/Kurwitu%20Ventures%20Ltd/documents/2022.PDF. No later filing exists, so the FY2021 year is the last full-year audited set. | CRON 2026-11-22: H1 2022 (six months to 30 June 2022) and FY2021 (year ended 31 December 2021) appended from the audited financial statements published as the 2022 annual report on the Capital Markets Authority resource centre (annualreport.cma.or.ke, INVESTMENT/Kurwitu Ventures Ltd, 2022.PDF, 23 pages, auditor Wamutu and Associates, IFRS for SMEs). The filed PDF is a scan with no text layer, so the figures were read by OCR at 320 dpi and then cross-checked by arithmetic: assets equal liabilities plus equity in both columns, non-current plus current assets equal total assets, total liabilities equal non-current plus current liabilities, equity equals share capital plus retained income, and retained income rolls forward from FY2020 by exactly the profit or loss for each period. Property, plant and equipment also rolls forward by the printed depreciation charge (107,660,430 less 164,997 = 107,495,433; 107,495,433 less 146,589 = 107,348,844). The company changed its year end from December to June, so the 2022 column is a six-month period and is labelled H1 2022 rather than FY2022. Group figures are used, matching the earlier columns. Amounts in Kenya shillings. No revenue line is printed in either period and no earnings per share is printed, so both stay blank; the taxation line is printed with no amount, hence nil.
